title: Tabula Vial
description: Where flasks empower the body, <keyword>Anointments</keyword> empower the hand. These are alchemical coatings for your tools, weapons, and Charges. Hold the anointment in one hand and press \[Use\] to apply it to the item in the other; not every coating suits every instrument, choose wisely. An anointment may also be applied via a smithing table where it takes the place of a smithing template, useful for two-handed weapons.

Unlike elixirs, anointments are <warning>not governed by time</warning>. They diminish with each use of the coated tool, fading stroke by stroke until spent. They are held in the <named>Tabula Vial</named>; ordinary glass cannot withstand the reactive compounds within.
